notes:
Lyriix Android v0.2.13

- Added Statistics for everyone, with no profile required: listening time, plays, the past seven days, top songs, artists, albums and full-song streaks. Open it from the side menu or your profile.
- Native playback records audible listening while the app is in the background, including downloads and phone imports. Paused time, buffering and seek jumps add no time. Completing a full song without seeking can qualify for a streak.
- Choose this phone's history or combined phone + PC statistics. Offline counts save privately and sync over paired Wi-Fi when Lyriix Windows v1.0.5 or newer is available. Retries and reconnects do not count the same plays twice. Earlier PC history is retained; mobile tracking begins with this update.
- Connect to a PC with its one-time pairing code. A profile or matching sign-in is no longer required. Existing profile privacy settings on the PC control whether combined statistics appear on its online profile. Guest statistics stay on the paired devices.
- Kept account isolation, encrypted PC credentials, certificate pinning, Wi-Fi-only music transfer, existing downloads, themes, voice controls, queue restore and permanent Android update signing.
